title: Onboard sable-13b v1.2 — perf profiles, metadata versioning, and changelog automation
author: Priya Nair
description: Onboard sable-13b v1.2 into the model registry with performance profiles, metadata/version bump, and automated changelog generation. Motivation: sable-13b v1.2 includes model-side fixes that materially change latency/kv-cache behavior for long-context workloads; publishing curated perf profiles and recommended serving configs ensures predictable cost/latency for customers. This PR: 1) Adds model metadata (models/sable/metadata.yaml) including versioned schema (metadata_schema: v2) and optional fields for quantization profiles; 2) Publishes performance profiles (models/sable/perf_profiles.json) for common instance types and sequence-length buckets with measured p99/p95 latency and throughput; 3) Hooks the changelog automation pipeline to generate a release-note snippet when a new model version is added (scripts/changelog/automation.py) and updates the registry automation tests; 4) Adds CI benchmarks harness entries and a small unit test and integration test to validate metadata schema and perf profile shape; 5) Updates docs (docs/model-registry/onboarding.md) with onboarding checklist and example serving configs. Checklist: - [x] Metadata file added and validated against schema v2; - [x] Perf profiles generated from nightly benchmarks and uploaded; - [x] Changelog automation emits structured snippet and includes model tags; - [x] Unit + integration tests added; - [x] Docs updated and cross-linked to perf dashboards. Related: ENG-4122 (perf onboarding), PM-198 (launch plan), SUP-8873 (support ticket for latency regression).
